paper.title_en: Meromorphic modular differential equations for the elliptic genus of Calabi–Yau varieties
paper.abstract_en: We study differential equations – not necessarily monic – for Jacobi modular forms. As an application, we derive a second-order differential equation for the elliptic genus of a K3 surface involving the logarithmic derivative of the modular invariant <math altimg="si1.svg"><mi>j</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>, and we explicitly find a third-order equation with a leading coefficient of weight 12 for the elliptic genus of any four-dimensional Calabi–Yau variety. Furthermore, we propose a simple recursive algorithm for investigating second-order differential equations with leading coefficient <math altimg="si2.svg"><msub><mrow><mi>E</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> or <math altimg="si3.svg"><msub><mrow><mi>E</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math>.
